get.summary: get employees by odata query options (returns only persons of type employee)
get.description: Be aware that a query made here can return up to 10000 records. If you need more, please use the built in paging functionality with $top and $skip.

parameters.name: $top
parameters.description: Limits the number of returned records.

parameters.name: $skip
parameters.description: Skips the first n entries of the response. Used for paging.

parameters.name: $count
parameters.description: Adds the total number of possible results with the given parameter

parameters.name: searchString
parameters.description: Search string for convenience search. See also the description of the searchStringLogic.

parameters.name: searchStringLogic
parameters.description:
Logic that has to be applied to the search string. SelectedFields is no longer supported and has no affect.

BasicFields: Applies the filter only to fullname, personal nr and current card nr.
PersonalNumberOnly: Applies the filter to personal number only.

post.description: Starts the generation of the employee export in the background.

parameters.name: $count
parameters.description: adds total possible results to the response

parameters.name: searchString
parameters.description: Search string for convenience search. See also the description of the searchStringLogic.

parameters.name: searchStringLogic
parameters.description: Logic that is to be applied to the search string. If no value is provided: 'SelectedFields' is applied. ('SelectedFields': Filter in fields provided in the select/expand clause, 'BasicFields': filter only in fullname, personal nr, badge filtering, 'PersonalNumberOnly': only filter in personal number)

Outside.description: 'false': persons in this room are considered present, 'true': persons in this room are considered absent.
